title: A Sunday Kind of Love (F major)

details.title: A Sunday Kind of Love
details.lead: Barbara Belle, Louis Prima, Anita Leonard and Stan Rhodes, 1946. The chorus as it is written, with the return to the sign and the coda in their place, in F major: concert B♭3 to E5. The pickup starts high on C and the A drops to the low C, then climbs in dotted rhythms back up to C; the middle part moves on G and A, up to E. In two, slow: about 80 quarter notes a minute.
